title.tr: Yatay lambri tahtalı açık renkli panel
title.en: Light timber panel of horizontal tongue-and-groove boards

alt.tr: Yatay lambri tahtaları birleştirilerek yapılmış, duvara dayalı büyük açık renkli ahşap panel
alt.en: Large light timber panel made of horizontal cladding boards, leaning against a workshop wall

caption.tr: Tahtalar dil-yiv birleşimle yan yana gelmiş, yüzeyde budak izleri var. Panel atölyede duvara yaslanıyor.
caption.en: The boards are joined side by side and knots show on the surface. The panel rests against a wall in the workshop.
